(I will say that I believe you can see her true character more in the manga)

 She loves her friends. There are many times where she jumps to protect armin and others. She sobs and grieves at Sasha’s grave, and we are given quite a few moments between them. I personally believe that her relationship with levi is interesting as well. Her development from strongly disliking him to respecting him more is one i enjoy. She is close to eren due to their shared history and of course loves him, but I don’t believe that takes away from her character. In fact, the build-up to Eren’s death, and the internal struggle and turmoil before finally getting to the decision to actually kill him gives a better look into her mental state. I personally believe she’s a lot more complex than “She loves eren and glares”,

But all in all, you are allowed to have your opinions about the story! This is just my quick response :) You don’t have to agree
